institution: Crosswalk Coliving, with upstream holding a seat
one_line: The same building, plus an upstream actor granted standing over it who then retracts three of the five commitments this building wrote. One line of vocabulary; nothing else differs.
analogue: Local fishers' own rules not recognised by the state that could override them — Ostrom 1990, ch. 5, on external authority undermining the right to organise.
